title: Flamenco Show & Special Menu at Torres Bermejas in Madrid
description: Immerse yourself in Spanish culture with a visit to Torres Bermejas, possibly the most important tablao (flamenco venue) in the world. This show and dinner package guarantees your seat in the legendary tablao where some of the greatest names in flamenco have performed. Your experience is completed by a selection of tapas and wine.

reviews.usertext:
Have been to many a flamenco show in a restaurant whilst having dinner, this is different. One hour show in a special location. The 5 person team were seasoned professionals and took the show to a whole new level.

Three dancers were outstanding the first blew the audience away as being honest probably didn't look like he would be so great....

We had show plus drink, they tried to charge for the drink, but when manager involved they agreed not to, seems odd, but the wine wasn't great, so reason I chased would have probably paid. Others who had dinner and tapas seemed to leave a lot so suspect food not great either. But really this is about an hour flamenco show which was fantastic.

Having seen all the reviews we felt we needed to give this a try and so glad we did. As we had already booked dinner reservations we opted for the 5pm performance. The venue was intimate and although full we were comfortable and had a good view of the stage. As we understood from other reviews the show plus drinks package included sangria so we opted to just buy drinks in the theatre which worked perfectly and were reasonable priced. The show lasts for about an hour (which we thought was enough) and consisted of three dancers, a singer and guitarist. The dancers were excellent and each provided a energetic and passionate performance accompanied by the guitar and vocalist. So glad we made the effort.

Holy ****, what an AMAZING show! If you do only one event in Spain, if you visit only one place, if you have only one day in Madrid, go here. Cancel whatever else you had going on for the evening, go here. Cancel dinner, never mind that tour, come and watch this show. The music, singing and good grief, the dancing 💃 🎶 🕺 is nothing short of incredible. The energy, the artistry, the skill, the passion... it is breathtaking. I've rarely been this impressed, but this show deserves every superlative you can think of. We had the Tapas menu, which was excellent. It cost €100 for 2 people, came with drinks (red wine and sangria) and we also had a bottle of sparkling water. This event is uniquely Spanish, and after it blows you away, you will remember it as one of the best things you've witnessed. Wow! Just wow!

Overall an average experience. The dancing was great and worth seeing. Instead of purchasing this with a meal I would recommend that you find tapas or dinner before or after seeing this show. We’ve been in Spain a week now and have been pleasantly surprised with meals everywhere, even in places we expected not so great food. On their website it mentions their chef is their “2nd art” so we figured it would at least be average food. We had two tapas meals and one guijara. The tapas were Luke warm, pan con tomate was soggy. Paella rice wasn’t cooked all the way and the seafood was very fishy (like not very fresh….we didn’t expect excellence here but at least cooked rice?). Our steak (entrecote) was cooked well done, it was tough and dry (they do not ask for preference).
Desserts we were expecting cheesecake and carrot cake as listed on their menu, we all got some version of an olive oil tart with what appeared to be Hersheys syrup drizzled over the top. Texture was weird, flavor was gingerbread like? Overall very gross.

Again, worth seeing the dancers and maybe grabbing a drink but do not waste your money or a meal on food here!

First time flamenco experience (Oct22) and the guitarist was full of soul and passion, the dancers exuberant and untiring plus a storytelling vocalist that must be good at what he does. However, DO NOT INCLUDE the food in your ticket as it was best described as pig swill. Entree was majority deep fried with only a couple of items okay and the main meal paella and chocolate cake desert inedible. That wasn’t only us as many plates nearby went back to the kitchen barely touched.

This show was my absolute favorite event during my entire trip. The skill of the performers is amazing and entertaining. The food was fine but the performance was by far a lot better. If you want to pay for the more expensive menu maybe it's better but honestly had a hard time enjoying the food because I was so entranced by the dancers.

The show was great. Save your money and pass on the tapas menu. They really pack them in so be forewarned the seats and tables are close together. The program lasts about an hour and goes by quickly due to the mesmerizing performance.

We ran a bit late and initially the guy hosting said it was ok. We were a bunch of Muslim girls and requested halaal meat and one vegetarian meal. He said it’s ok. We received all vegetarian meals and one drink. The food was not great. It was bland and tasteless. The waiter was very sweet and kind. When the show ended, we were told, you need to get out in a very aggressive way. He did not speak like this to other white patrons. Otherwise the show was very good. The passion and creativity of the dancers triumphed the host experience we had.

A really enjoyable evening. We bought out tickets on the trip advisor app, arrived 15mins early to a small queue outside, we're shown to out seat after a short wait and the show began. I did read up on the history of flamingo dancing quickly before the show started and felt it gave the dancing a little context for us. The room is beautiful, the dancers are so talented and the hour flew. A lovely start to a night out in Madrid.

This was a wonderful flamenco show and a great value! I had tickets to another club, but I learned about this one from someone I met at an intercambio. A friend and i got the tickets from Groupon for 40 € for the both of us, and it included drinks and a lovely spread of tapas and a dessert! The show itself was absolutely incredible, and the dancers and singers performed with so much passion and emotion. It was mesmerizing. Highly recommend 🤩✨

I couldn't have asked for more! Highly energetic and professional show. The three dancers, one singer, and one guitar player kept me entranced the whole time, and the cozy location in Moorish deco helped create an atmosphere. I didn't have any food, but the beer was good and reasonably priced.

The highlight of our time in Madrid! We all got the tapas menu and the food was very good. Get there 30 minutes early when the doors open so you can eat part of your meal before the show starts because once it starts you will forget you have food in front of you! The show is amazing! The dancers, singer, and guitarist are all so talented. So engaging and truly special! A Madrid must!

Disappointed !!! Went there expecting a real Flamenco show in Madrid , since I’m a Flamenco lover and have watched many shows in other places, even in other countries. This was just showing mens and one woman with no dress, they were not dancing, and no couple dance of Flamenco! This dance is about the woman empowerment and there was just one woman with no dress, but wearing pants! Where is the tradition? Also I’ve seen in Buenos Aires and on Cruises much better and beautiful and gracefully performance then this. By the way the food was bad.
I want reimbursements, it’s totally Trip Advisor false advertising saying it was excellent and Best Seller! I want my money back and full reimbursement !!

A must see while in Madrid! We went as a family of 4 (kids ages 13 & 14) to celebrate my 13 year old’s birthday. We all loved it! The dancing was mesmerizing, guitar and singing wonderful and he setting is beautiful. A garden of delights. We got the tapas menu for 2 - just enough to keep us entertained.

The location is very central- steps from the Gran Vía and a 10 - 15 minute walk from Puerta del Sol/Plaza Mayor.

Overall would definitely recommend!!

The performers were simply magnificent! It was an hour brimming with a display of the performers talent, skills and not hard to see how much practice they have to put in to give us some great entertainment. Get a taste of Spain by attending this show and having a meal. You won't regret it. Top Notch!

Fantastic experience at the flamenco show at Torres Bermejas. It was a very intimate venue with as many tables squeezed into the space as possible, and even on a Monday evening the venue was packed! The performers were amazing and we were in awe the whole time. An absolute must see, so authentic!

Great place and fabulous dancers! Beautiful tablao!!
Well organized to be seated and tended to. I wasn’t sure if we could order more drinks or food besides the package we had bought. The servers were very attentive but busy.
The 5pm (1hr) show was great for us, great to sit after a busy day sightseeing and we could go elsewhere for drinks and dinner afterwards!
The sangria was just right, not too sweet! The venue is cozy and small enough that you can get a good view to the stage from all angles. My husband is not necessarily a flamenco music fan but I love it. This was a perfect mix of traditional singing more sevillana or maybe farruca, not bulería which tends to be the more agitated (as he would say ‘noisier’) singing. So my husband enjoyed it a lot too! We definitely recommend it!

My wife and me enjoyed the show and the location.
The artists are very engaged and great performers (from my little understanding of flamenco), the location is great and the service very good from check-in to exit.
Would definitely recommend to pay a visit.

This was a great show. 2 singers, a guitarist, 2 female and 1 male dancer. Thoroughly entertaining the whole hour. They allow video taping, no flash.

Pretty packed in so recommend buying the drink as you will get a table. Those that don’t buy the drink online get the row seats in the back. That said intimate setting and believe easy to see from anywhere.

As others mentioned. Go early as no assigned seats.

A fantastic show with great performers, dancers and musicians. The venue has a beautiful and intimate atmosphere which makes the show intense and absorbing.
Breathtaking at times.
I thoroughly recommend this show and venue.

Don’t waste money on the tapas. The octopus was very chewy, the tortilla was tasteless, the croquettes were still frozen in the center. Sit in the middle of the room or you’ll get sprayed with sweat. The dancers worked hard but I expected more I guess.

FANTASTIC SHOW! Highly recommend. The venue also made it easy to switch our booking to a different time as we wanted to add more people.
The food was delicious. Ambiance was 100% GORGEOUS and the dancers were amazing. So happy to have went and made my trip to remember.

Thoroughly enjoyable evening in this authentic venue. The highlight is obviously the Flamenco show and the three dancers and accompanying duet of singer/guitarist put on an enthralling show between them. This is a real must for anyone visiting Madrid, especially if you haven’t seen Flamenco dancing live before.

What you might not expect from this sort of venue, is a comfortable table near the stage and a very enjoyable Tapas meal to enjoy served surreptitiously during the performance. Really enjoyed our evening of entertainment

The show is absolutely amazing! The performance Is thrilling and the setting is intimate but beautifully decorated. The dinner and service of some of the waiters was very disappointing. I recommend the Steak Dinner because the Tapas was very small and you not great. I have diet restrictions and didn’t see options when I bought our tickets (or food description). Outside of that, go see this show!

This is the old Spanish culture. Should try to see a Flamenco show if coming to Spain, especially this venue. The room was gorgeous and so were the dancers. Service was top notch. We only got drinks, but you have the option to get a dinner show.
DO NOT show up late or right at the start time or you will be seated in the very back. Seating was not assigned. We got there right at the start time, seated in very back, we still could see the show, but I would have preferred closer.
DO dress up. This is a very nice place. I am glad my boyfriend and I looked nice or I would have felt out of place.
Fantastic time. Sangria pretty good as well.

Great experience and the show was brilliant. The food and service was great, we recommend it to anyone and if we go back we will go to the same show. The location is easy to find and close to everything around the Gran Via.

The actual show was good, the dancers were amazing but the service wasn't great. We weren't acknowledged when we arrived. Everyone who had paid for food seemed to receive great service but we had to ask a waiter to come to us twice. I'm unsure if this was because we didn't buy the food package but we thought we could add it on the night. We had to also ask the manager to bring our wine over which wasn't what we expected we had to do especially as people coming in after us, we're quickly served.

After waiting so long we didn't bother with adding food and left as soon as it was finished.

I was travelling alone in Madrid and was keen to see as much of the city and culture as possible.
The show lasted about an hour and the food was nice.
Where the EXCELLENT 5 stars come in, is the service and people working there. They’re warm and friendly- happy to chat to a lonely traveller taking in their city.
The waiters and manager made the entire experience a really lovely evening- I could have stayed for hours more. I stayed longer than the show and was given a glass of cava- a lovely treat
A real pleasure and highly recommended x

S#$T A@@ grin on my face. Have not stopped smiling. Passionate performance, fantastic introduction to the craft of Flamenco. Enjoyed the live guitar, the singer, the Male dancers, the lovely female dancer. So, so, happy to have seen this show. The showroom is small enough that there isn't a bad seat in the house. I chose to pre order food, thinking we would be seated at a better table, and we were on second row, just saying. Food is not the star of the show, but is efficiently served and fine.

Wonderful …. It was a lovely experience , the show was great!!!!! The food was good , I only have one comment is that the servers were rushing us through the menu, which is really two plates and one drink . I’m general a very lovely hour

I totally recomand this performance.A day before i saw another flamenco show but didn t arrive to this level.
Beside great location in stile mauro,the show was incredible.The dancers ,the costumes ,the singers.. all of a very high professionalism.
Beautiful and impressive indeed!

Wow - excellent flamenco show, very passionate, three dancers, a singer and guitarist. Beautiful intimate room. Tapas we’re super tasty (people with food get great seats by the way). Would highly recommend

Great show, very close to the stage, a little 'crammed in' but added to the atmosphere.
An hour was enough for us, real enthusiasts would probably appreciate more.
We didn't eat but the Tapas looked like a good plate full.
Sangria was very good.

Flemenco Show and Tapas close to Puerta del Sol. The show was amazing. 3 professional dancers, a singer and very talented guitarist. Show lasted about 45 minutes. I had the pre-fix tapas menu. It was basic. Better tapas other places. Beautiful room for the performance. Small place, holds about 60. Not a bad seat in the house. Highly recommend the show.

Second time going to this Tablado in spain. Amazing amazing. The performers are very skilled.
food provided is very good , and wine amazing

Strongly recommend it. Make sure to make reservation

Our hotel kindly phoned to book this show for us for same day. We paid at the door. €35 drink only, €50 drink and tapas, €65 drinks and Ala carte. Amazing show, one hour guitar, singing and two ladies flamenco dancing. The place is beautifully decorated, yet crammed with guests. You eat while watching. Tapas were ok’sh. Thoroughly enjoyed it.

The show was wonderful…. Very talented, very crowded and tight space. Food was below average, I’m happy I did it but probably wouldn’t recommend. I’m sure there are better places a little further out of the tourist area

Dinner, sangria and the show were great! We were impressed! The waiters were very nice and helpful! Great service. Great show! Definitely better show than other flamenco show in Madrid (cardamomo was much worse than this show!). it was a mother son trip and my 14 year old son was impressed!

Hi we have not seen the show due it being shut for Covid but we have not been informed of this, they have taken our Euro but are clearly not going to supply the show, no email, no refund - i only found out by looking at their Facebook page. So disappointed. Have tried emailing, phoning and messaging them no reply.

Really not atmosphere. Lost a star due to view you in my seat. Massive pillar in the way on one side . Drink was fine, glad we didn’t get the food. But the dancers and singer was amazing. Very talented.

Absolutely stunning show. Any of the complaints or bad reviews I can't agree with. This is about the show and not the food or drink. 5 STAR SHOW!! We had a glass of red wine which was good. We didn't need another glass as we enjoyed watching this amazing show.
The show was exceptional, but dinner did not worth the money paid. I highly recommend the show. Just go there , order a bottle of wine (around 16 euro) and enjoy the show with a glass of wine.

Our taxi ride from our hotel took 20 minutes... but we were transported back in time. Arriving at the cobblestone street entrance you feel the “ energy”...
the narrow doors lead to a mini foyer and steps leading down to the showroom.
The matrieD hands you off to a “ runner” who shows you to your table. You are transported into a Moorish “ casbach”... tiled walls, wood, leather, red! A tiny “ stage”
And tables throughout the room. There is a second floor dining room. But seeing the show would be difficult.
The tables are set with standard cutlery , heavy napkins and floor length cloths.
Your waiter takes your drink order and the food starts coming out of the kitchen.
The food is not memorable! Well, you don’t go for the food?!?!
But the FLAMENCO is!
Without any fan fare or announcement a dancer “ appears ” on the stage. Hands up. Stern face. The guitarist, OUTSTANDING TALENT, begins a slow melody, gently plucking the guitars strings... and the show begins!
After the single dancer a group of three take the stage... each one representing the Folkloric Flamingo dance. And , the GUITARIST, a huge talent.
The show ends just as it began. No announcements, no fan fare.
It’s over!
It’s a show that’s well worth seeing.

The venu was amazing with it's decor and underground setting. We walked there and had no trouble finding it coming from Sol.

Food was just okay, not the greatest tapas, but we came for the dancing.

Performance was great from seeing an older/experienced dancer to the understanding how the guitarist/singer and dancers all feed off of each other as they are dancing. Truly unforgettable and would highly recommend not leaving Spain without checking this place out!

The dancing and music was very beautiful. Don't expect to go for a great meal. The food is not that good, we had the tuna and it was a thin dry piece. I'm not sure how the seating works but we paid for the expensive meal and got a table right up to the stage. The decor was beautiful and the dancing was elegant. The guitar player was truly amazing. You go for the experience of the Flamenco

Worthwhile flamenco show. Great singer, guitarist and three dancers. It was very entertaining even for people with not much knowledge of the genre. We had tapas which was pretty uninspiring- if ryanair did tapas this would be it!

Confirmation #: 1083975950
Booking Reference #: 677029494

On 1 Jan 2019, I and a party of four others, attempted to attend the 1900 show. We arrived just at 1900 and queued. After about 15 minutes we could hear the reservation manager shouting "Impossible! It is impossible!" to waiting patrons, then explained that the theatre was full. We thought nothing of this as we had reservations in hand... Turns out so did the dozen or more people in front of us. We finally made it to the front of the line (the show is 10 minutes in progress at this point) to ask for admission or a refund. The manager told us to return for the 2100 show, that our reservation was no longer valid.

We walked around and returned at 2030 to another long queue. When the doors opened at 2110, we waited to be seated. The manager again started turning people away (I assume for not having reservations.) We made it to the front of the line and were seated. As the show progressed, we were given a beverage but our dishware was taken from the table. We asked a waiter about our food and he told us that our table was for customers who did not order dinner. We all showed him our receipts which listed the "Tapas menu" in the price. He said he would come back after he checked. We never saw him again.

This theatre appears to be EXTREMELY ill-managed, staffed with over-stressed, poorly trained employees. With the exception of the performers... Their part in the evening was extraordinary.
Outstanding show! Highly recommend! The staff was courteous and efficient, and the talent...wow! We had the meal included and it was a nice taste of Spain.
OLE!!! OLE!! OLE!!! A MUST SEE!! I had chills seeing them dance and sing with so much emotion! EXCELLENTE BABY!! I’d do it again!
The food and show were both good. It's just that I had to eat in the dark and there wasn't much time for eating (~1 hr). Other things were fine. A good place to watch a flamenco show.
It was great to see the dancers perform. The Flamenco dancing has such spirit and energy. I would definitely recommend this.
What a fantastic show!!!! The flamenco show was one of a kind. The dancers were so energetic. The singer and guitar player were great. The restaurant was fantastic This is a must see.

My wife and I attended this and we chose the option to have vegetarian meal added to the ticket.
The show itself was OK-but not up to the hype of the advertising.
The vegetarian meal was barely adequate
The Service was perfect and friendly, the atmosphere was amazing, the music only and the artists too woow. Nice traditional place with great design. Delicious food

1) Like others have repeatedly said on here, the food is absolutely awful. It's all really cheap simple, baked food, obviously to keep food costs to a minimum and maximise profit. The main was a chewy bit of meat on bread to make it bigger with fake paella (noodle with only the flavour of seafood). No one in our lerge group of about 20 people enjoyed any of it. You would not even want to pay 5 Euros for the food.
2) The venue is badly run and does not do to what it says; we asked if they could congratulate our friend getting married. After confirming In writing they failed to do it on the night and acknowledged this afterwards. Not even a member of staff mentioned anything to wish us well after spending 1000 euros there.
3) The waiters never smile and look like they hate working at the venue. Flamenco performance aside there was little fun or atmosphere to give you a great night out.

Definitely a place to avoid and there are plenty of better places to choose for Flamenco in Madrid.
Amazing show, performers were astounding, passionate and incredibly talented. The drinks were extortionately priced, even for simple soft drinks, yet overall a brilliant evening. Would recommend
Amazing ambiance and so much energy on the stage! I was truly impressed by the articism of the performers. Guess, it will be one of my deepest impressions after visiting Madrid.
Great drama and passion in the dance. Unforgettable experience, one to think about. Great venu also. Only drawback is that I would have loved it to last longer.

This Flamenco experience is a must for any traveler visiting Madrid, the performance was full of passion and the dancers were excellent.
The audience enjoyed the show and was exuberant throughout giving the performers a long round of applause at the end of the evening.

I can not say enough about this experience! The atmosphere, dancers (3), music (guitar player and singer) were nothing less than SPECTACULAR! We were riveted! Our dinner (tapas) and wine (red) were fantastic. This is not to be missed by anyone visiting Madrid!
We got a seat that was not with the best view, also, we were not aware that we had not purchased food and had to purchase it directly there.
The quality of the performers was awesome!!!!! Incredible how one guitar and the sound of clapping hands and heel tapping can make a concert! Amazing dancers!
The show was amazing, a bit crowded and the food was just average but the show was definitely worth it. Get there early for a good seat.
A raw, powerful and dramatic flamenco show. We loved it! The venue was intimate so we were right by the stage! Would highly recommend.
It was an unforgettable experience watching the 3 dancers perform. Their performance was full of passion for the dance. We did this on our last night in Spain - i would recommend this.

If you are in Madrid you must come see this performance!!! It was absolutely amazing/spell binding!! I am a professional musician in the states & this appealed both to my musicality as well as my flair for authentic travel experiences!!!
Amazing experience! 10/10! Highly recommend to anyone visiting! But don’t be late! Show was intimate. High energy. Food was amazing. Wine was excellent! Service was amazing!
Superb experience. You’ve gotta do it. The performance was very good, great food and you meet the nicest people.
Enjoyed the enthusisium that the dancers danced with. Talented. The tables were a little too close together.
That was absolutelly great show. High profesionallas! Fantastic dancers, great guitarist and vocalist. Highly recommended.
We were 12 girls going to the show and really liked it. It was nice that there were three different dancers. The sangria was really tasty as well :)

Its scam. Server and organizer dont speak English.
Server drop food which we didn’t asked for . At end of show charge 70$.Show was very short.
Recommend use other flamenco show .
3 dancers who performed passionately accompanied by excellent guitar and voice. Really enjoyable. Small and decorative venue
It was our first time to visit Spain and watch a live Flamenco dance and surely we had a great time. The show was great! We enjoyed it so much. We were glued from start to finish.

Exceptional show; I believe I got the full Flamenco experience.
Only criticism is the confusing presentation of dining options; I mistakenly thought I could decide in the restaurant, but everything was so tightly organized that I only got my drink (my error).
Great dancing! Very fun. Sangria good. Tapas and paella hard to eat in dark. Especially shrimp with legs, eyes and shell...
Great show! An experience to remember! Great deal. Sad the show was only an hour! Amazing dancers and energy1
Fantastic show, tapas and drinks!!!! The dancers were passionate in their dancing and the live singer and guitarist were the icing on the cake!!!!

Incredible aithentic and up close experience The dancers were magnificent and the atmosphere old world cozy The host most gracious as ww were late bought us an extra glass of wine and saved us a table Well worth the trip!
Fabulous show and good tapas. Great deal for the price though I wish the show were longer than an hour.

I had low expectations for this because it is geared to tourists. I was pleasantly surprised at how enthusiastic the dancers were! The space was really nice, too. Small enough so that everyone could see, and beautifully decorated.
We walked out after 15 minutes. It is an old and outdated performance, so are the performers . I do not recommend, do not waste your money.

The dancers were amazing as was the singer and guitar player. They dance with such emotion.

We bought the tapas/show. The tapas were 3 stars. Not very good but they did feed you a lot.
We had such a great evening here, the entertainment was fabulous. The staff were all very friendly and welcoming. Must see if you are visiting Madrid.
Food was basic and decent. The show was excellent! Something we’ve never done before and really enjoyed it. The setting was gorgeous
What a treat this was! The venue is quaint and beautifully decorated. The performers were outstanding! Highly recommend!

Wonderful music, song and dance for an hour- not to be missed!
Such a shame there’s food being served up in the middle of it all!
Really enjoyed the evening. Dancing was fantastic to watch complemented by a good tapas experience. Only 1 issue was the inability to purchase a second drink.
Show was great. Food not so good. Steak was tough and couldn’t even cut it. Would recommend just watching the show and skip the meal
Incredible dancers! The singer was absolutely amazing, along with the classical guitarist. Great food :)
Highlight of our whole spin trip! Incredible experience….amazing!!!! The Dancers singer and musician so talented! ❤️💃🍷

We were a group of 4 and got there about 10 min late. Our table was reserved. This is a small venue. Tables were very close to each other. I was expecting a more elaborated show, with the traditional and elaborated female dress, head piece, and "castanuelas". Repetitive dance routine. Only one drink is included per ticket.
Excellent show! Great example of flamenco to my untrained eye. Beautiful venue, and we didn't eat, but the food smelled wonderful.

By far the highlight of our Madrid trip. We couldn’t take our eyes off the show/performers. Happy we got dinner before and only went for drinks at this location because it was hard to do anything but watch! Highly recommend !!!
An absolute must if you want to experience the real passion and essence of Madrid. Lovely tapas and super show! Beautiful traditional decor. Just wonderful 💖
Amazing show, great dancers, singers and musician - brilliant atmosphere, I would definetely recommend!!
It was a great show from what I could see. I was behind a huge column and missed about 1/3 to 1/2 of the show because of the column. My seat should have never been given to anyone!
We had a fantastic time and felt very immersed and engaged in the whole experience. Definitely worth going.
This was an excellent show! We took our grandsons, 13 & 10 and they even enjoyed it! The experience was fantastic! Highly recommend!
Flamenco show was great. The food was by far the worst I had during my 1 week stay in Madrid. Go for the show, but eat somewhere else.
It was exciting, unforgettable experience to watch and listen such a synchronized artists ☀️ enjoyed and loved it ❤️ 💃 🕺

The Flamenco itself was superb, but the so called tapas (at an extra €25 was probably worth about €10!!
The service was at best ok.
I would recommend the show, but not the food.
Very good show. High qualaty dancers and and a exciting view into Spanish culture. I can recommend this show to all ages.

A well organized experience with plentiful food and wine. We ordered the tapas & a tinto. Very nice. The 3 dancers were excellent, the waiters were efficient, and the setting was intriguing. Far better than I expected!
The show was really fun to watch. Lots of energy. Music was entertaining. Seats are a little small and they pack it in. But it was a lot of fun.
Must visit event. It’s right on the grand via. If you are in Madrid for even 2 days. It’s a must visit place
The show was brilliant, no more words required. You have to get to this show. Food was great as well. So pleased I went as soon as I got to Madrid. 10/10
Perfect night with the perfect dinner especially curated for us because are vegetarians. The hosts are the most warm people you’ll meet and the dancers are the most talented people you’ll see 😊
Truly amazing experience! The hosts prepared a special vegetarian tapas option for us and the flamenco performance was truly unforgettable!
Very intimate and unique experience. The artists themselves are very talented. We definitely recommend viewing. The show itself was about 45 minutes in length.
Fantastic show - everyone is recommended to attend and enjoy it once even though we may not know this art and its culture tradition. It excites me to learn more about it.
5 artists, all of them were brilliant, fantastic place and atmosphere, good price, lacationin the centre of Madrid, 20 m from Gran Via

The show was AMAZING!! All dancers singer and musicians were so professional and talented!

The sangria was good, the waiters were so friendly. Thank you for the great experience.
It was an incredible experience with amazing dancers and good drinks. The service was great. I would recommend it to anyone.
Decided to go to the show last minute and we’re so happy with our decision. Loved every minute of the show, truly enjoyable by all from 16 years old to 60!

Fantastic time! Loved the show. Great dancers. Crowded room. Small tables. Worth the crush. Only had drinks. Customers getting food get the best tables but food just average per our friends who ate but maybe worth the better view up front?

The performance was enjoyable. However, the food was literally inedible. If you decide to get a ticket for this, I must recommend you do the show only and don’t try the tapas. You will leave with regrets.
The show was a great experience with a lot of emotion. Food and drinks were good. Hosts were even better. Definitely an experience not to be missed when in Madrid! Gracias!
Prompt service, would recommend coming before the show by 10 minutes. Show was very good, just signal to the bar staff when you want a drink ;)

Recommend to only get the ticket for the show as the food is overpriced.
The show is only an hour so there is not enough time to enjoy both the show and the food.
We had an amazing night here! Great show and delicious food! Very friendly staff! The performers were breathtaking, I want to start getting flamenco lessons asap haha
Flamenco is awesome! The dancers and venue were great but the food is not worth it. I was solo and am young so I defs could of went to a cheaper one, still happy I went tho!
Authentic flamenco show. Chose show +Drink option. Perfect evening entertainment. Downside, small venue so felt a bit squeezed in.

Great experience, the place is amazing all theme decorated and the performers were amazing, the dancers and the singer all on point. The food was ok. Overall a great experience to truly feel the flamenco
It was a must see show with excellent dancers very high quality and the place was super nice! I just reccommend it to everyone, even with older children!
Amazing show! The venue is very intimate so you are very close to the performance. I highly recommend this show to anyone

I booked this tour through TripAdvisor my party arrived 15 minutes before the 5:00 p.m. show. We waited in line for about one half hour and then the host could not find our reservation. Eventually, he did find it and we were taken to a table that was very tightly located in front of a door. One of my guests had to get up 3 times during the show to let the waiter pass through. This definitely took away from being able to enjoy the show fully.
It was my first & I thought I’ve enjoyed it thoroughly. The atmosphere was thick, the culture was rich, the music & dance was electrifying!! One must go & experience it for yourself!!

Average Joe-schmo family here.

- Show is SPECTACULAR and worth going to.
- Place is crowded. I mean crowded. Expect to be seated pretty much shoulder to shoulder with the next seated table.
- The Food. Not worth it at all. If I could rate the food I would give it a 0 out of 5.
We got the tapas menus and we quickly realized everything from the calamari to the paella and the dessert was subpar if not worse. Honestly if I go again, I would just order a glass of cold water and enjoy the show. Beer was not good either.
Wife enjoyed the sangria though.
- Seating arrangements, ok so the bigger the group the further from the stage you will be. The tables front of stage are all for couples. Tables of 3-4-5 ppl are seated further back. Either way it’s a small area so you will still get a good show.

Would I go again. YES! 💃
Would I recommend. HIGHLY recommended.
Would I order the food. NO, just get food after the show at a restaurant.

Absolutely loved the show, the dancers were so passionate and energetic. We bought just the ticket (without food or drink) and then bought a bottle of wine there to share for around €20 which worked out much cheaper!
The show was great, really talented performers and it felt very authentic. Also the location is ideal

Well
Worth a visit .very energetic show. If you only have one night make sure you do this ! We just had the drink option and it was fine .
The good selection , drinks and service were excellent . The passion and technique of all the performers - dancers, singers and musicians were amazing .
Fantastic night night of dancing, singing and music. The atmosphere was superb and the show was spellbinding. Staff were very friendly and the manager was very welcoming. Would very much recommend.
The show was great, but the food was okay. The atmosphere was great. It was easy to find. Would highly recommend.
An Excellent combination of music, singing and dancing. The trio of dancers had very contrasting styles, nevertheless each performance was mesmerising in their own right.
Amazing show and atmosphere ! Me and my friend book also the special menu that included tapas, paellea and dessert plus sangria.
Very good show, the dancers the singer and the guitarist offered a wonderful show. The service is wonderful.
The show was excellent. Dancers were amazing. My only complaint is that the place smelled of fried fish. Not pleasant

Torres Bermejas was easily one of the best experiences I’ve had Madrid. From great sangria, to an amazing show, and personable service Torres Bermejas was an unforgettable experience! For anyone looking for the perfect blend of culture and party head to Torres Bermuda’s
The most amazing show. Hosts were so kind and welcoming, the talent of the show was absolutely incredible, mind blowing! A memory my friends and I will cherish forever.
This was the best show my friend and I have ever seen! The service was absolutely lovely Juan Jose mediado took care of us and was so kind! Would recommend to everyone!!!!

Torres Bermejas
What a show , just amazing, best show i've ever

seen in my life…..

The artists were very passionate

also very nice staff.
The service was outstanding! The performance was phenomenal with 3 dancers, guitar player, and singer. There is not a bad seat in the house. Highly recommend!
Was my first time watching flamenco and really liked it. Beautiful place and great dancers. Highly recommended
It was a great show in the heart of the city. Not bad value for money and would recommend it to anyone who wanted to get a taste of flamenco.
Everything was AMAZING !!! The show went on for one whole hour and the service was sooo nice. All of them very professional. I absolutely recommend it.

We’ve had an excellent experience here with an amazing flamenco show and very good food! Our waiter, Juanjo, made the evening even more enjoyable - perfect service! I will definetly repeat it when I have visitors in Madrid!
Wonderful evening! What a spectacle! Can’t recommend it enough. Food was great and staff very friendly. The music and dancing is incredible. Well worth a visit
Unbelievably beautiful performance from the musicians and dancers! So intense and authentic. The food was also delicious. I would recommend this to anyone visiting Madrid.
Great evening showing real passion! Food was ok, good sangria as well ! Good service, nice people. Amazing place and deco.
You have to get out to this show. The performers were all excellent, the food was amazing (and portions were quite big), and the venue was exquisite. Highly recommend!
Had a fantastic time at the Torres Bermejas show. I got the vegetarian menu, my wife got the tapas menu, both were great, and the performance was the highlight of the evening.

Great night out! Room was beautiful, dancers were passionate, musicians were talented, food was delicious, atmosphere was fun. Not tacky in the slightest, we were pleasantly surprised. Highly recommended as great value with tapas and wine included.
